Two papers were accepted for publication at the 23rd EG Conference on Visualization (EuroVis 2021):

  • Willy Scheibel, Christopher Weyand, Joseph Bethge, and Jürgen Döllner: "Algorithmic Improvements on Hilbert and Moore Treemaps for Visualization of Large Tree-structured Datasets"
  • Bastian König, Daniel Limberger, Jan Klimke, Benjamin Hagedorn, and Jürgen Döllner: "RoomCanvas: A Visualization Technique for Spatiotemporal Temperature Data in Smart Homes"
